description: Adds Devin CLI mem reading; lazy SQLite pages; task/session binding fixes
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- `trellis mem` can read Cognition Devin CLI sessions from `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db` (`--platform devin`). This is not Desktop/Cascade `trellis init --devin`. Live CREATE TABLE comments are stripped; Devin forests do not fall back to max(node_id). (#614)

**Bug Fixes:**
- SQLite mem readers load main-file pages on demand instead of the whole database. (#596)
- Pi headless subagents forward ask-policy prompts to the parent session. (#611)
- Active-task lookup no longer binds another session's task when the current session id is missing. (#608)
- `task.py archive` restores child `parent` links if it stops after unlinking some children. (#613)
notes: `trellis mem --platform devin` reads Devin CLI sessions. No file migrations required.
